product_metadata.title: Jim Shore Heartwood Creek Santa with Peacock Stone Resin Figurine, 9.75”
features: “Santa with Peacock” figurine from the Jim Shore Heartwood Creek collection
Combines traditional themes with folk art designs
Captures Santa in beautiful hand-painted detail
Accurate details handcrafted in high-quality stone resin
description: Jim Shore’s hand-carved Heartwood Creek collectibles impart a sense of hope and nostalgia, embracing inspiring themes of family, tradition, spirituality, and patriotism. Santa looks resplendent in opulent jewel tones, colorful glitter accents, and the decorous feathers of his peacock friend. Part of the Winter Wonderland collection, this 9.75” handcrafted figurine makes a stunning centerpiece for holiday meals. Every detail is meticulously sculpted from stone resin and hand-painted by our team of skilled artisans. About Us: Enesco is committed to bringing joy every day. The premier global destination for high-quality giftware, plush, and home décor, our prestigious family of brands includes: GUND, Department 56 Village, Gregg Gift, Foundations, Jim Shore Heartwood Creek, Disney Traditions by Jim Shore, Walt Disney Archives Collection, Disney Showcase Collection, Disney by Britto, Pusheen, Designs by Lolita, Our Name Is Mud, and many more.
